title: Jacques Vallee's movie project shifted to Lazar

tellings.quote: somebody was talking about making a movie with him. And then after hearing about me and talking they started talking about Well, maybe we won't. We'll do it on Bob instead. And he was super pissed off.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar says that in the 1990s people were planning a movie about a man named Jacques Vallée, but after hearing about Lazar and talking with him, they decided to make it about Lazar instead. Lazar, who tells it from his own side, says Vallée "was super pissed off" about it.
